text:
I had the opportunity to use the clinic's services. It's very convenient to get there, as it's accessible by MRT; you can get off at Bang Khun Non station.
After your dental appointment, besides finding a 7-Eleven and Starbucks next to the clinic, you can also continue shopping along Bang Khun Non Road, which has lots of delicious food options. 🥰

The clinic focuses on high-quality services at affordable prices. Importantly, the dentist is very kind and gentle. Today, I went for a teeth cleaning. At first, I thought I would need fillings because I had a checkup elsewhere 6 months ago that showed cavities, but the dentist checked thoroughly, and it turned out I didn't need fillings.
Actually, there were no cavities at all. So, today I only had my teeth cleaned, which was great. The dentist also taught me the correct way to swallow saliva to prevent my tongue from pushing against my lower front teeth, which can create gaps between my teeth. 🙂
The clinic accepts social security insurance without requiring upfront payment, making it convenient for dental care for people in the Charoen Krung area. ^^

If you're planning to take care of your dental health, or have plans for braces, dentures, dental implants, etc., and want to see a kind and gentle dentist,
the clinic has many great packages.
I highly recommend it! ✨✨✨
